Hello I'm Timothy Harvey a Master's student at the University of St Andrews. I did some Lean during my undergrad, and I've been working towards formalizing the Vagner–Preston representation theorem (every inverse semigroup embeds into the symmetric inverse semigroup on itself the inverse semigroup analogue of Cayley's theorem).

Is anyone else working on this, or on inverse semigroups in Mathlib more generally? I'd like to avoid duplicating effort and would be happy to compare notes. I have been pulling directly from @Re'em Melamed-Katz GitHub repo.

If there's interest, would this be a good candidate for a Mathlib contribution? I'd appreciate advice on how best to align my existing work with Mathlib conventions (e.g., whether to build on PEquiv for partial bijections).

Happy to share what I have so far. Thanks!
Ideally you should tag the user if mentioned like that -- @Re'em Melamed-Katz . If you must copy paste from the AI you will have to annotate it manually unfortunately.
